change.all_pairs_crossover: Evaluate all pairs at 64 images or fewer.
change.descriptor: Reuse the frozen B1 exposure-normalized structural descriptor only to nominate expensive local-feature pairs.
change.selection: For larger batches, take the union of each image's 12 nearest structural neighbors. Include every exact distance tie at the boundary and deduplicate unordered pairs.
change.verification: RootSIFT, RANSAC, tri-state classification, dual-view negative-veto fusion, and support-aware grouping remain unchanged; structural proximity never creates a group edge.

evidence_boundary: Evaluate candidate recall, graph connectivity, and exact predictions only on the six already-used Phase 2 and Phase 3 development folds.
Use nested sample subsets for runtime scaling only; do not use their scores for selection.
Do not rerun the Phase 1 reserved slice or touch a protected holdout.
Do not run dual-view all-pairs over all 2,126 medium images.
hypothesis: A generous top-12 B1 structural screen will preserve every support edge needed by the frozen dual-view partition across all six development folds while reducing expensive candidate pairs below 20 percent of all pairs on 100-image batches.
rejection: Reject or increase the predeclared screen only if candidate recall/connectivity or exact-group gates fail; do not relax local matching, state, fusion, or grouping thresholds to compensate for a retrieval miss.
